children: Ondas completed the acquisition of Gate and Bron through a Share Purchase Agreement on September 14, 2026. The consideration includes $105.0 million in cash, 10,689,655 Ondas common shares, a $25 million working capital adjustment, and approximately $22.5 million in additional shares to be issued within nine months, subject to post-closing obligations. Shareholders may earn up to $185 million more in stock over two years based on milestones. In a related Registration Rights Agreement, sellers agreed to daily trading limits of 15% of the stock’s 10-day average volume, while Ondas will promptly file resale prospectus supplements to support orderly liquidity.
